title: hooks/session_start.sh prints one WARN line at SessionStart when origin has no stable branch
why: A session silently runs on main when the stable branch is missing, so nobody learns the child repos run unpinned.
source: Lane merge-flow-after-anthropic (session_013NEJL2oxYMVKoXseeKacVG), R42 part 2 fix-after, via the coordinator 15:36 CST Nov 13; read at main 59da758a3. Item (f). Completes P9 (coordinator 13:03 CST Nov 12), one WARN and a fall back to main.
note: Filed 15:36 CST Nov 13. install.sh on main falls back (fall_back_to_main, about L458 on the old lane head); hooks/session_start.sh prints no WARN: its bounded_fetch adds the stable refspec only when ls-remote lists it, and the pin logic falls back to origin/main quietly (builder read, ad0e8d66b). Fix: one WARN line at SessionStart when origin has no stable, once per session, with a test in hooks/test_session_start.py. Departs from nothing. Note: stable does not exist until a green main run (coordinator 15:36). Past rulings not checked.
